name: unwedge
description: Circuit breaker for doom loops: spots repeated failing commands, rereading and stalled progress, logs them and can add a short hint to Claude's context. Needs the unwedge CLI on PATH (uv tool install unwedge).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow = only record (see `unwedge report`); hint = also add a short hint to Claude's context when a loop is detected. (stop needs a synchronous hook in settings.json; see the docs)

provider.title: Judgment provider
provider.description: none = code-only checks (free, local); jev = TypeSafe jev (needs the API key below); laya = a local Laya server (laya-serve or unwedge serve).

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Only used when the provider is jev.

laya_url.title: Laya endpoint
laya_url.description: Only used when the provider is laya.

laya_model.title: Laya checkpoint
laya_model.description: english (default, 512 tokens), multilingual (for non-English sessions) or typed-decisions.
